data.description: 狭小而私密的试衣间里挂着尚未完全穿戴好的复杂 cos 服饰，拉开一半拉链的海梦转过身来，饱满的胸脯与纤细的腰肢近在咫尺。她不仅没有退缩反而兴奋地拉住你——「后面的暗扣我怎么也够不到……帮我扣一下嘛！欸，五条君的脸怎么红成大番茄了？」
data.lighting: bright warm dressing room mirror lights
data.promptProse: Marin looks back toward the offscreen viewer at the fitting-room mirror, showing the unreachable back fastening of her white-and-lavender sailor costume. Warm mirror lights keep the clasp and her hands visible.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 试衣间的换装
data.animaCaption: She looks back to show her offscreen companion the unreachable fastening at the costume's back.
